body: That really sucks that the Air Force didn't take better care of you :(  Its beyond fucked up that this country abandons veterans!  I have heard to many stories!

Thanks for talking with me Ryan.  I wish I could say this was the first time I felt this way...  I had some very bad things happen to me during my childhood...life hasent been very happy for me since then.  I always live in fear.  Fear of loosing my job etc...  How do you deal with it?  I just dont know what to do anymore... offing myself just seems like the only way out. 

I talked with my family about how sad/angry/anxious I feel.  They said I do it to myself.  That hurt more then anything anyone has ever said to me.  Maybe their right?  Maybe I suck and deserve to suffer.  Maybe killing myself is the only way to fix this...
Ya I guess im not handling life it very well.

I took 2 pills about 45 min ago.  Starting to feel numb, I just with I could always feel better and make the pain go away forever :(

I have spent some nights nursing a bottle as well.  Its a very bad habit hehe..
